title: Avril Lavigne announces birth of baby with just 6 words
text:
Avril Lavigne baby born: Who is the father in Instagram photos? NFL NBA NHL MLB WNBA Outdoors Casinos Newsletter POP-CULTURE Avril Lavigne announces birth of baby with just 6 words
 Charles Curtis For The Win Nov. 13, 2026, 1:43 p.m. ET Congratulations to Avril Lavigne, who announced the birth of a baby girl on Instagram, which surprised fans everywhere on Friday -- no one seemed to know that Lavigne was expecting.
 And on top of that, we don't know who the father of the child is. You'll recalled that Lavigne was married to Deryck Whibley from Sum 41 before they broke up and she married Nickelback front man Chad Kroeger. They also divorced.
 While fans wonder who the father is, check out the announcement, which was captioned: "Our Mini [Expletive] Princess has arrived," accompanied by photos of the singer holding the baby, three sets of checkered Vans sneakers and two hands holding on to the baby's fingers.
 WARNING: NSFW language ahead.
